title: People & Culture Lead
description:
**Company Description** **Strategist. Trusted Advisor. Change Agent. Future Builder.**


We're looking for a People and Culture leader who moves the dial, not just the process. You'll lead where it counts: at the intersection of people, performance and commercial outcomes. By partnering with senior leaders, you will turn strategy into workforce reality, aligning capability, culture and leadership so teams deliver with clarity today and are prepared for tomorrow.


You bring evidence, judgement, and inclusive leadership, earning the right to challenge and facilitating better decisions, faster.

**THE MOMENT WE'RE IN**


AECOM ANZ's People \& Culture function is mid\-transformation. We are transforming not just our processes, but also the influence, credibility and commercial edge of the team. We are investing in the growth of our people, in modern operating models and AI\-enabled ways of working that amplify human potential and prepare our workforce for tomorrow.


We need a leader who is at the forefront of this change. Someone who builds trust with executives and creates a safe space for constructive challenge, who can shape decisions and culture that deliver impact. Above all else, someone who balances conviction with pragmatism and keeps outcomes and people at the centre.

 **Job Description** **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Partner where the decisions get made.** Own the P\&C relationship with senior business leaders. Be their first call, their trusted sounding board and their strategic partner. Understand the business, bring the people lens and translate direction into workforce strategy.

**Lead and grow a high\-performing team.** Lead, coach and develop a team of Business Partners setting clear direction, priorities and high expectations. Build capability, succession and confidence and model the inclusive, values\-based leadership you want to see across the business.

**Shape culture and capability.** Spot where culture needs to shift and lead the interventions that move it. Drive talent and succession planning, build leadership capability through coaching and partner on the development pathways that keep our best people growing.

**Plan the workforce of the future.** Partner on workforce planning and organisational design, using people metrics; industry trends and talent intelligence to identify future capability needs; then lead structural and BAU change with a clear point of view and ownership of the outcome.

**Navigate complex ER with confidence.** Triage and resolve complex employee relations matters promptly and effectively, exercising sound judgement, pragmatism and empathy. Navigate the Fair Work Act and the ANZ employment landscape confidently to provide timely, balanced advice while demonstrating care for all parties involved.

**Make the data tell the story.** Turn engagement, turnover, exit and inclusion insights into action. Spot the risks and opportunities early and influence action that shapes culture.

**Champion AI and innovation.** Be the advocate for AI and automation in how P\&C works. You don't need to be a data scientist. You need to be curious, early to experiment and willing to bring the team with you, so technology sharpens decisions and frees practitioners to do the work only humans can do.


We don't need a People \& Culture leader who waits to be asked. We need someone who walks into the room with a strong presence, who listens deeply and is ready to share their insights. Someone who enhances our culture. Who backs their views with evidence and is unafraid to make the uncomfortable call when the data demands it. A leader who embraces innovation and fosters a fun, collaborative environment. That's the bar. That's who we're looking for.

 **Qualifications** **WHO YOU ARE**


You've done the time, and you've come out the other side knowing the best practitioners are part strategist, part coach, part diplomat and occasionally part referee. You're not easily rattled. You've sat across the table from hard conversations and come out with the relationship intact and the right outcome achieved.


You prioritise the right things over the comfortable things. You communicate with clarity and flex your style without losing your message. And you see through the noise to what the business actually needs — even when that's different from what it thinks it needs.

* Team leadership and people development
* Stakeholder influence and executive presence
* Workforce planning and people strategy

* Change management built for adoption from day one
* Process improvement and digitisation

* Fair Work Act, NES and ANZ employment law literacy
* Risk\-informed, legally sound decision\-making

* Talent management and succession planning
* Performance coaching and capability uplift
* Data\-driven insight and decision\-making
* A genuine appetite for AI in HR practice

description:

Chorus is a Western Australian not\-for\-profit providing aged care, disability, and mental health services across Perth and regional WA. * Lead the build of Choree, Chorus’s AI\-native knowledge management chatbot — a conversational tool that lets staff ask questions and get direct, contextual answers drawn from Chorus’s knowledge base, rather than searching through documents or waiting for a colleague.

**Power Platform Development**

* Design, build, and maintain Power Apps, Power Automate workflows, Power Pages, Co\-Pilot Studio AI agents and Dataverse solutions that reduce manual effort and improve how information flows across the organisation.

* Help grow Chorus’s internal digital capability by mentoring colleagues, uplifting Power Platform confidence across the organisation, and contributing to a culture where technology is understood and owned from within.

You are a strong Power Platform practitioner ready to grow. You bring depth in the Microsoft ecosystem and genuine enthusiasm for stretching into AI and adjacent disciplines alongside a collaborative team.

**Essential**

* 3–5 years hands\-on experience building custom products and solutions with Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Co\-Pilot Studio and Dataverse.
* Experience with Microsoft Dataverse configuration, Dynamics 365 integration, and Power Platform governance and lifecycle management (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Power Platform Build Tools).\[RV8]
* Experience designing and deploying automated workflows, integrations, and user\-facing applications across web and mobile.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability — able to translate complex business needs into reliable, scalable solutions.

* Effective communicator and active listener, comfortable translating complex technical architecture into user\-friendly language for frontline, non\-technical staff.
* Collaborative working style, open to learning and a genuine growth mindset — willing to step into new areas including AI as the role evolves.

* Ability to develop detailed solution designs for digital products — translating business and user requirements into well\-structured technical specifications, architecture diagrams, and integration designs that a development team can build from.

**Desirable**

* Exposure to Azure AI services — Azure OpenAI, AI Search, or Bot Service — particularly for building intelligent, knowledge\-grounded applications.
* Familiarity with Azure services (Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Entra ID, API Management) and third\-party system integration.

* Experience designing and implementing back\-end data and integration flows — including API development, data pipelines, and event\-driven architectures using Azure services such as API Management, Service Bus, or Data Factory.

**About WPP**


WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. Are you seeking an exciting role with significant opportunities for leadership and growth? Then you might be the Senior Data Insights Consultant we are looking for!


**What will your day look like?**


As our new Senior Data Insights Consultant, you will join our growing Technology and Data team. Here, you will be a key leader in helping our clients make data\-driven decisions to enhance their digital communication on an enterprise scale. This entails designing, enabling, and delivering complex data solutions and integrations for various campaign platforms. More specifically, your tasks will include:


* Architecting, building, and delivering value\-adding insights solutions, serving as a key advisor to clients on how to leverage their data assets to optimize large\-scale communication strategies.
* Performing advanced analysis to uncover actionable patterns, trends, and opportunities that directly inform client strategy and decision\-making.
* Designing and running test\-and\-learn programs (A/B tests, incrementality, holdouts) across channels to measure impact and continuously optimize communication performance.
* Partnering with senior stakeholders to define strategic business questions and translating them into robust analytical frameworks and data roadmaps.
* Supporting or leading the data\-stream on complex, large\-scale projects with globally recognised brands, ensuring that data solutions and integrations are designed and delivered for scalability and business impact.
* Driving ongoing proactive client ideation — identifying new opportunities, use cases, and data\-driven initiatives that help clients grow their business.
* Helping drive agentic AI adoption, exploring and embedding agentic solutions into our data and insights workflows to enhance efficiency and client value.
* Providing answers and insights to business\-related questions via automated reporting solutions as well as ad\-hoc data analyses, including building reports and insights dashboards within marketing platforms such as Adobe and Salesforce.
* Mentoring, reviewing, and advising less senior team members — elevating quality, fostering technical excellence, and supporting their professional growth.
* Collaborating with highly skilled specialists including Account Managers, Architects, Developers, Creatives, Strategists, Data Scientists and Marketing Operations experts to service our clients coherently.

**Who are you going to work with?**


You will join a team of hands\-on Data Insights Consultants, Data Scientists and Data Engineers who are passionate about bringing value and knowledge from data. We are all about unlocking insights from data through analytics and making that insight applicable in 1:1 data\-driven communication and CRM. Your work will always be firmly anchored in data in a cross\-disciplinary setting, collaborating closely with highly enthusiastic experts from Strategy or Creative backgrounds.


**What do you bring to the table?**


As a person, you possess a strong consultancy mindset, demonstrating resilience, curiosity, and an eager\-to\-learn attitude. You combine this with strong business acumen, allowing you to understand and anticipate client needs effectively. You are outgoing and love being part of interdisciplinary projects and solutions. You are eager to learn and quick to understand the complexity of high\-tech dialogues and solutions.


Furthermore, you have the drive, enthusiasm, and technical credibility to act as the primary data and insights advisor for senior client leadership, guiding them through complex challenges and inspiring them to grow their business. It's an advantage if you have consulting, agency experience or marketing domain knowledge, but it's not a requirement.


In addition, you have:


**Technical skills**


* A minimum of 5 years of experience in a consultant/business liaison role related to data, BI, analytics or reporting solutions. Can independently design, build, and optimize modern analytics solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and ready for real\-world production use.
* Write, debug, and optimize complex SQL queries, ensuring clarity, efficiency, and production readiness.
* Design and build scalable dimensional data models from raw source systems (fact/dimension structures, performance\-aware design). Apply strong data modelling principles, governance standards and practices that ensure data accuracy, consistency, and security.
* Develop and manage DBT transformations using layered architecture, including testing and documentation best practices.
* Build production\-ready Power BI semantic models and dashboards, including advanced DAX measures, performance optimization, and secure data access (RLS).
* Work collaboratively using GitHub, following structured branching, pull request, and code review workflows.
* Familiarity with or a strong interest in the application of AI and agentic frameworks, and machine learning principles to generate conversational analytics, predictive and advanced marketing insights.
* Comfortable working in modern cloud data environments (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Fabric).
* Understanding the data structures and reporting capabilities within major marketing and martech platforms (e.g., Adobe Campaign/AJO, Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Ability to build and deliver reports and insights dashboards natively within these tools is a strong advantage

**Interpersonal skills**


* **Technical stakeholder management and influence**: A proven ability to build trust and act as a strategic partner to senior\-level clients and internal leaders. You can confidently navigate complex, technical stakeholder environments and influence decision\-making through data\-driven reasoning.
* **Communication and storytelling**: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex data concepts and insights into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and senior business audiences.
* **Consultative and solutions\-oriented mindset**: The ability to critically assess complex business challenges, ask probing questions to uncover root causes, and propose robust, data\-driven solutions.
* **Leadership and mentorship**: Proven experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members. You actively foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team.
* **Autonomy and critical thinking**: You are a self\-starter who can think critically, identify issues and opportunities autonomously, and take the initiative to propose and implement corrective actions.

A leader in personalized customer experiences


VML MAP is a world\-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer\-centric. Together, we are 1000\+ technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55\+ nationalities.


A global network


We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150\+ offices in 60\+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences.
